content: TanStack Query default staleTime=0 causes immediate background refetch on hydration (double-fetch risk) in Next.js App Router SSR. Use HydrationBoundary with prefetchQuery in Server Components/layout.tsx, or pass raw server data as initialData for simple cases. Next.js server cache (fetch cache/revalidate) and TanStack Query's browser cache are two separate layers that must be coordinated.
